name: get_onboarding_status
title: Get onboarding status
description: Return explicit onboarding state: draft, magic_link_created, claim_page_viewed, email_verified, ready_to_publish, live, or blocked with reason. claim_page_viewed is a human open of the claim page (claim_opened_at); it is not inbox proof. email_verified is POST confirm or 6-digit code only.
